_doc: Hyperparameters for non-smoke full runs of fno_coregionalization. The smoke pipeline in smoke_eval.py uses SMOKE_DEFAULTS; this file documents the larger config that should be used when wall-time is not the constraint. Not read automatically — kept as a reference for future cycle Builders to wire in once the per-call timeout is relaxed.

_rationale.K: Larger basis (20 vs 10) better expresses the coregionalization across continuous m; the paper uses K=20 on Poisson.
_rationale.n_blocks: Deeper FNO captures finer-scale spectral structure once epochs allow it to fit.
_rationale.modes: More Fourier modes (16 vs 12) keeps higher-frequency content; only useful with enough capacity downstream.
_rationale.hidden_channels: Double the channels — capacity bumps that are budget-prohibitive at smoke scale.
_rationale.epochs: 400 vs 200 to let cosine schedule fully anneal at the larger model size.
